title: Diazoma recipe v1
description: A recipe tells RecipeAdapter how to read a site that does not publish the Diazoma site-compatibility spec. It is data: no code, no regex on HTML (regex only on extracted strings).

match.description: Chrome match patterns. A recipe never applies outside them.

resize.description: Rules that turn an image URL into smaller copies (spec 3.5).

match.description: Plain text the absolute image URL contains (not a regular expression).

image.description: The card (about 512 px): replaces the first match, or a template with {url} (the URL percent-encoded) or {url_raw} (as it is).

image_focus.description: The focused card (about 1024 px): replaces the first match, or a template with {url} (the URL percent-encoded) or {url_raw} (as it is).

image_full.description: What the viewer opens: replaces the first match, or a template with {url} (the URL percent-encoded) or {url_raw} (as it is).

fixtures.description: Paths relative to the recipe file. Every shipped recipe has at least one.

pages.description: Path globs on which the list applies.

fields.description: Item field name to extraction rule. Dotted names (meta.price) fill nested objects.

sel.description: CSS selector inside the item; absent means the item itself.

re.description: Applied to the extracted string only. At most 200 characters. A pattern that can backtrack exponentially (a backreference, a repeated group that holds a quantifier or an alternation) or has more than two unbounded quantifiers is refused at run time, and so is a string longer than 2048 characters: the field is dropped with a warning.

url.description: Template with {page} and {query}. {page} is the page number, or the offset when page.step is set.

start.description: First page number. With step: the first offset (default 0).

param.description: Query parameter that carries the page number, the offset (step) or the continuation token (next).

step.description: Offset paging: the value sent is start + (page-1)*step.

next.description: JSONPath on the response to a continuation token (sent in param) or an absolute URL (fetched as is). No value ends the paging.

items.description: JSONPath (RFC 9535) selecting the item array or items.

fields.description: Item field name to a JSONPath evaluated on one item, or a template over the item's own values.

apiField.description: A JSONPath, or { template } where {a.b} placeholders are values of the item (percent-encoded, unless the template is one placeholder).

apiAspectField.description: Like any api field, or { w, h }: JSONPaths of the pixel width and height; aspect is w/h, dropped unless both are positive.
